from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import permutations, product

# 9 balls: 6 red (2 labeled 1, 4 labeled 2), 3 blue (1 labeled 1, 2 labeled 2)
balls = [("R", 1), ("R", 1), ("R", 2), ("R", 2), ("R", 2), ("R", 2),
         ("B", 1), ("B", 2), ("B", 2)]
N = len(balls)

# Sanity check on the composition of the bag
assert sum(1 for c, _ in balls if c == "R") == 6
assert sum(1 for c, _ in balls if c == "B") == 3
assert sum(1 for _, n in balls if n == 1) == 3

# Part (1): drawing with replacement, exact enumeration of all 81 ordered outcomes
total1 = 0
fav1 = 0
for i, j in product(range(N), repeat=2):
    total1 += 1
    a, b = balls[i], balls[j]
    reds = (a[0] == "R") + (b[0] == "R")
    if reds == 1 and a[1] + b[1] == 3:
        fav1 += 1
p1 = Fraction(fav1, total1)
claim1 = Fraction(8, 81)
print("Part 1 total outcomes:", total1)
print("Part 1 favorable outcomes:", fav1)
print("Part 1 computed P =", p1)
print("Part 1 claimed P =", claim1)
print("Part 1:", "CHECK PASS" if p1 == claim1 else "CHECK FAIL")

# Part (2): drawing without replacement, exact enumeration of all 72 ordered pairs
pairs = list(permutations(range(N), 2))
total2 = len(pairs)
cntA = cntB = cntAB = 0
for i, j in pairs:
    A = balls[i][0] == "R"
    B = balls[j][1] == 1
    cntA += A
    cntB += B
    cntAB += (A and B)

PA = Fraction(cntA, total2)
PB = Fraction(cntB, total2)
PAB = Fraction(cntAB, total2)

print("P(A) computed =", PA, " claimed = 2/3")
print("P(B) computed =", PB, " claimed = 1/3")
print("P(A and B) =", PAB)
print("P(A)P(B) =", PA * PB)

print("P(A) check:", "CHECK PASS" if PA == Fraction(2, 3) else "CHECK FAIL")
print("P(B) check:", "CHECK PASS" if PB == Fraction(1, 3) else "CHECK FAIL")
independent = (PAB == PA * PB)
print("Independence claim (independent):",
      "CHECK PASS" if independent else "CHECK FAIL")
